Subject: Dalmora Grill Holdings - Referral Required

Hi Leon,

Thanks for the submission on Dalmora Grill Holdings. I've reviewed the information and have a complete package to work with.

However, this risk requires referral to senior underwriting before I can proceed with a quote. Here are the concerns:

• All 3 locations fall within 16 km of the coast
• Our existing portfolio already has high concentration in this coastal zone (within 25 km), creating accumulation exposure

Given our current appetite constraints around coastal concentration, this may be challenging for us to quote competitively. I'd recommend reaching out to a specialty market with broader coastal appetite, such as [specialty carrier names in your market].

Happy to discuss if you'd like, but wanted to give you a quick response so you can explore other options.

Best regards,
[Underwriter name]
